verdict.rationale: SavvyCal has a published pricing page that lists what plans include: unlimited calendars, assistant delegation, booking pages on your own domain, and emails from your own address. A Premium tier is named as the plan that unlocks custom domains and hides the SavvyCal badge. However, the evidence shows no dollar figures, no per-seat billing model and no full tier-by-tier breakdown. missing for 10: actual per-seat price figures, confirmation of per-seat billing, complete tier comparison of costs and inclusions, independent corroboration.
